title: Your annual physical: what to expect

media.alt: Slide 1 of 5, deep green, with the Ellenton Family Practice Direct logo: The annual physical. Your annual physical: what to expect. What we go over, what to bring, and why once a year. Swipe.

Slide 2 of 5, sand: What we go over. Your health history and medications. Screenings and vaccinations you may need. Any ongoing condition, like blood pressure or cholesterol. The questions you have been saving.

Slide 3 of 5: a photo of the practice's roadside sign on Highway 301, Ellenton Family Practice Direct, Family Medicine, on a lawn under a blue sky with clouds, over the words Our sign on Highway 301, 907 25th Dr East, Ellenton. The logo and familypracticedirect.com at the foot.
Slide 4 of 5, deep green: What to bring. A photo ID. Your insurance card, if you have one. A list of your medications.

Slide 5 of 5, cream, with the logo: Once a year keeps your history current. Book your annual physical. Mon to Fri 9 to 5, Sat 9 to 2. An amber Call 941 417 7386 button and familypracticedirect.com at the foot.

Video of the 5 carousel slides in order: Your annual physical and what to expect / what we go over: your health history and medications, screenings and vaccinations, any ongoing condition, and your questions / the practice's roadside sign on Highway 301 at 907 25th Dr East, Ellenton / what to bring: a photo ID, your insurance card if you have one, and a list of your medications / book your annual physical by calling 941 417 7386, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
